conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; FUNC + MUTE opens the SOUND menu of track BD; four DOWN and YES open SOUND SETTINGS; two DOWN select ENV RESET (FILTER); then LEFT, LEFT, RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT. ER74 shows AMP, OFF, AMP, FILTER, AMP+FILT, AMP+FILT; stock 1.74 with the same input shows OFF, OFF, FILTER, FILTER, FILTER, FILTER. Every screen up to the first LEFT is identical on both.
